description: Record a question for the operator and deliver it through configured notification channels.

commands.usage:
usage: orchid notify [--task <id>] [--choice <value>]... [--objection] "<text>"
Journal a fenced blocker and emit its question ID. Each --choice is one alphanumeric-led [A-Za-z0-9_-] token, at most 64 characters. --objection is reserved for paging the task's existing operator objection; model-originated notices cannot mint that authority through the broker.
